latest_release.name: v2.72.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

Changes since v2.71.0:

* Bump version to 2.72.0 (526ebce1)
* Remove vendored Anthropic document skills (docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx) (f7a50ed2)
* docs: add illustrated guides for all scientific skills (ed4cea6c)

hot_issues.title: [Bug]: security-triage.md describes an outdated security scan
[Bug]: citation-management: --manuscript check misses biblatex and natbib citation commands, so cited references are reported as unused
[Bug]: pkpd-modeling: logistic exposure-response reports non-convergence on AUC-scale exposures; SE is not the Fisher information
[Bug]: analytical-method-validation: M10 checks fail results exactly on the limit; intermediate-precision df can exceed N-1
[Bug]: pathogen-variant-surveillance: mutation_profile --nucleotide --gene main returns nothing on single-sequence instances
[Bug]: citation-management: duplicate-DOI detection is case-sensitive, so the same paper twice passes validation
[New skill]: field-onboarding - step-by-step orientation in an unfamiliar research field
